verses.text: Of David, when he pretended to be insane in front of Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left. I will praise the LORD at all times. My mouth will always praise him.
I will boast about the LORD. Let humble people hear it and be glad.
Join me in telling of the LORD's greatness. Let's honour his name together.
I looked for the LORD, and he answered me. He rescued me from everything I was afraid of.
Those who look to him shine with joy. Their faces are never covered with shame.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him. He saved him from all his troubles.
The angel of the LORD camps around those who respect him, and he rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. Happy is the person who goes to him for safety.
Respect the LORD, you his holy people, because those who respect him have everything they need.
Even young lions may be weak and hungry, but those who look to the LORD will not be without any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me. I will teach you to respect the LORD.
Do you want to enjoy life and live long enough to see good days?
Then keep your tongue from evil and your lips from telling lies.
Turn away from evil and do good. Look for peace and chase after it.
The LORD's eyes watch over those who do right. His ears listen to their cries.
But the LORD's face is against those who do evil. He will wipe out any memory of them from the earth.
Good people cry out, and the LORD hears them. He rescues them from all their troubles.
The LORD is close to those whose hearts are broken. He saves those whose spirits are crushed.
Good people may have many troubles, but the LORD rescues them from all of them.
He protects all their bones. Not one of them will be broken.
Evil will kill the wicked. Those who hate good people will be found guilty.
The LORD rescues his servants. No one who goes to him for safety will be found guilty.
